risks.label: Liberation Day Tariffs — April 2
risks.detail: Sweeping reciprocal tariffs take effect April 2. VIX above 30, worst-case pricing across equities. Sectors most exposed: autos, semis, consumer electronics, agriculture.

risks.label: Oil Supply Shock — WTI $102+
risks.detail: WTI crude at $102.60, USO +12.67% weekly. Largest weekly oil move since March 2022. Supply fears + OPEC discipline + geopolitical tensions in Middle East.

risks.label: VIX Above 30 — Sustained Fear
risks.detail: VIX at 30.61 for sustained period above 30. Structural risk-off regime. Options premiums elevated. Market pricing recession + tariff double shock.

risks.label: S&P 500 Down 9.4% From ATH
risks.detail: S&P 500 at 6,344, down 9.4% from Feb ATH of 7,002. Nasdaq -13.4%. Bear market territory approaching for growth names.

risks.label: China Retaliation Risk
risks.detail: Beijing signaling readiness for targeted countermeasures on US agriculture and energy if Liberation Day tariffs proceed. Trade war escalation could reshape supply chains.

risks.label: Russell 2000 Weakness — Small Caps Hit
risks.detail: Small caps leading decline, Russell 2000 -1.46% Monday, -2.71% weekly, -11.7% from ATH. Most sensitive to domestic economic weakness.

risks.label: Stagflation Risk — Oil + Inflation + Fed Hold
risks.detail: Oil above $100 + inflation sticky + Fed on hold = potential stagflation. No rate cuts available while growth is slowing and prices rising.

opportunities.label: Gold ATH $4,590 — Safe Haven Rush
opportunities.detail: Gold futures at $4,590, record high. Tariff uncertainty, central bank buying, declining real rates. Entry on GLD pullback to $414.50, TP $430-450.

opportunities.label: Long TLT — Bond Rally Continuation
opportunities.detail: TLT up 1.33%, bouncing off 52W low of $83.30. If tariffs trigger recession scare, Fed forced to cut. Entry $86.80, TP $90-94.

opportunities.label: Silver Breakout — $72.20
opportunities.detail: Silver futures at $72.20 (+2.67%). Riding gold coattails with industrial demand kicker. SLV ETF at $63.52.

opportunities.label: European Outperformance
opportunities.detail: FTSE +1.61%, DAX +1.18%, CAC +0.92% vs US weakness. Rotation from overvalued US mega-caps to European value. Euro weakness boosting exporters.

opportunities.label: Energy Sector — USO +12.67% Weekly
opportunities.detail: Energy is top-performing sector as oil supply concerns persist above $100/bbl. USO +4.53% Monday alone.

opportunities.label: Short QQQ — Tech Breakdown
opportunities.detail: Nasdaq -13.4% from ATH, sell-the-rally pattern persisting. Most exposed to tariff supply chain disruption. Short entry $560, TP $520-540.

events.label: Liberation Day Tariffs — Apr 2
events.detail: Wednesday April 2 — Reciprocal tariff announcement. Binary event for all global markets. Maximum headline risk window.

events.label: EU CPI Flash March — Today
events.detail: Eurozone flash CPI for March due today. Below expectations strengthens ECB rate cut case for April meeting. Key for EUR/USD.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI — Apr 1
events.detail: Tuesday April 1 — Key manufacturing gauge. Watch for tariff-driven price spike and activity slowdown.

events.label: NFP Jobs Report — Apr 3
events.detail: Friday April 3, 8:30 AM ET — March employment report. Critical labor market reading amid tariff chaos.

events.label: Q1 End — Rebalancing Flows
events.detail: Last trading day of Q1 2026. Pension fund and institutional rebalancing creating mechanical flows. Stocks down = potential buy pressure.

events.label: China PMI Returns to Expansion
events.detail: China Manufacturing PMI 50.4 (vs 50.1 expected, prev 49.0). Non-manufacturing 50.1. Possible front-loading of exports before tariffs.

events.label: German Unemployment — Today
events.detail: German unemployment rate expected at 6.3%. Europe's labor market barometer. A miss adds to Euro-area weakness narrative.

events.label: Iran Hormuz Deadline — Apr 6
events.detail: Monday April 6 — Trump ultimatum for Iran to reopen Strait. Binary event: compliance or military escalation.
